## Lab 07 Assignment - Group 20

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(broom)  # devtools::install_github("tidymodels/broom")
library(cowplot)
```

```{r}
biopsy <- read_csv("https://wilkelab.org/classes/SDS348/data_sets/biopsy.csv")
```

```{r}
pca_fit <- biopsy %>% 
  select(where(is.numeric)) %>% # retain only numeric columns
  prcomp(scale = TRUE) # do PCA on scaled data

pca_fit
```

```{r}
pca_fit <- biopsy %>% 
  select(where(is.numeric)) %>% # retain only numeric columns
  scale() %>% # scale data
  prcomp() # do PCA

pca_fit
```

## PLOT 1 - Maria

```{r}
pca_fit |>
  broom::augment(biopsy) |>
  ggplot(aes(
    x = .fittedPC1,
    y = .fittedPC2,
    color = clump_thickness
  )) +
  geom_point(size = 1.5, alpha = 0.7) +
  labs(
    x = "PC1",
    y = "PC2",
    color = "Clump thickness"
  ) +
  theme_half_open(12) +
  background_grid()
```
